trials.claim: The seller promises automated AI hiring that boosts productivity, saves time and eliminates scheduling with video interviews
trials.claimQuote: Automate Hiring with AI: Boost Productivity, Save Time, No More Scheduling with Video Interviews
trials.reasoning: A buyer reported finding no AI functionality and another said candidate videos did not show up on the dashboard. The positive reviews show time saved on screening, but do not confirm the promised AI or reliable video interviews.

exhibits.quote: Candidates apply, but their videos don't show up on our dashboard.
exhibits.argument: Missing interview videos directly undermines claims of time-saving automated video hiring.

exhibits.quote: I also did not find any AI functionality.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reporting no AI functionality contradicts the promise of automated AI hiring.

exhibits.quote: This software has been well recieved by the applicants as well but has also saved us around 2 weeks of time on hiring for this one job.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the product saved weeks of time on hiring using video screening.

exhibits.quote: Instead of spending hours on basic screening, we let the software handle the first steps.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms automated handling of first screening steps saves hours.
